options: He doesn't ___________ such a simple lie.

questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 단어 및 표현이 들어갈 수 없는 것은?

<보기>
rely on, influence, spread, miss, end
questions.explanation: '그는 그런 단순한 거짓말에 속지 않는다'라는 흐름으로 빈칸에는 fall for 또는 believe 같은 표현이 들어가야 하며, end(마치다)는 들어갈 곳이 없다.

questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 영영풀이가 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?

<보기>
ⓐ shopper: someone who sells something
ⓑ effect: a change that is caused by an event, action etc.
ⓒ souvenir: a piece of paper with information about your payment
ⓓ product: a thing that someone grows, produces, or creates to sell
ⓔ budget: the amount of money you have to pay for something
questions.explanation: ⓐ shopper는 '구매자'이며, 주어진 풀이는 seller의 뜻이다. ⓒ souvenir는 '기념품'이며, 주어진 풀이는 receipt의 뜻이다. ⓔ budget은 '예산'이며, 주어진 풀이는 price의 뜻이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장의 개수는?

ⓐ Look at the woman and her dog which are playing happily in the yard.
ⓑ You may feel sick if you eat too much fast food.
ⓒ He made a robot dog which can rescue people.
ⓓ If you will not listen to me, you will regret it.
ⓔ We saw something that glow in the dark.
ⓕ I don't know if it will snow tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 어법상 어색한 것은 ⓐ which → that (선행사가 '사람+동물'인 경우 that 사용), ⓓ will not → don't (조건절에서 미래는 현재시제), ⓔ glow → glows (something은 단수 취급) 총 3개이다.

questions.question:

ⓑ Do you know that girl who is standing by the door?
ⓒ The boy that is wearing a yellow jacket is my nephew.
ⓓ The weather of Jeju is warmer than that of Seoul.

ⓕ I believe that he will pass the English exam.

questions.question:
Somi: I'm ⓐlooking for a lipstick for my mom. Salesperson: How about this? Somi: Expensive! I thought ⓑwhich I could buy a lipstick for 30 dollars. Salesperson: This is also popular. Somi: That's better! Hold on, Somi! Your budget is 30 dollars, but you are buying a 40-dollar lipstick. The 40-dollar lipstick sounds ⓒcheap only because the salesperson showed ⓓto you a 50-dollar lipstick first. This is an example of the anchoring effect. Usually, the first piece of information becomes an "anchor" and ⓔinfluences the shopper's decision. In your case, the 50-dollar lipstick was the anchor. Somi, don't just ⓕrely on the first piece of information that is given to you.

Hunger Marketing Junho: What? The sale ends in two hours? If I don't buy the sneakers now, I will have to buy them at a higher price. Stop, Junho! You're buying the sneakers just because you don't want to miss the sale. You're falling for a hunger marketing strategy. If people can buy a product only for a limited time, they often feel "hungry" for it and want to buy it. About missing the sale, don't worry, Junho. You'll soon see a similar sale again. Viral Marketing Yuna: That's the hottest dress on social media now. Lots of people are wearing it. I have to get that dress, too! Wait, Yuna! You only want the dress because you saw it again and again on social media. It isn't just you. There are a lot of people who fall for a viral marketing strategy. Why? Information about a product can spread quickly and widely on the Internet, just like a "virus." If a product becomes hot on social media, people naturally want to have it. Yuna, just remember that a popular product isn't always right for you. Anchoring Effect Somi: I'm looking for a lipstick for my mom. Salesperson: How about this? Somi: Expensive! I thought I could buy a lipstick for 30 dollars. Salesperson: This is also popular. Somi: That's better! Hold on, Somi! Your budget is 30 dollars, but you are buying a 40-dollar lipstick. The 40-dollar lipstick sounds cheap only because the salesperson showed you a 50-dollar lipstick first. This is an example of the anchoring effect. Usually, the first piece of information becomes an "anchor" and influences the shopper's decision. In your case, the 50-dollar lipstick was the anchor. Somi, don't just rely on the first piece of information that is given to you.

questions.answer: who are wearing uniforms, which are eating leaves, which is walking, has
questions.question:
다음 그림을 보고 <조건>에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 넣어 문장을 완성하시오.

[그림: 동물원에서 아이들이 코끼리와 기린을 보고 있는 장면]

(1) The children _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ are looking at animals.
(2) There are two giraffes _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ from the tree.
(3) The elephant _____________ _____________ _____________ slowly _____________ a long nose.

<조건>
• 적절한 주격 관계대명사를 각각 사용할 것 (that은 제외할 것)
• 각각 현재진행형 시제를 사용할 것
• leaves, wear, walk, uniforms, eat, have를 한 번씩 사용할 것 (필요시 변형할 것)

※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: (1) 아이들(사람)을 수식하므로 who 사용, wearing uniforms와 함께 현재진행형. (2) 기린(동물)을 수식하므로 which 사용, eating leaves와 함께 현재진행형. (3) 코끼리(동물)를 수식하므로 which 사용, walking과 함께 현재진행형, have a long nose 구문 사용.

questions.answer: If Kevin goes straight one block and turns right, will start washing the dishes if, presses the blue button
questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 접속사 if를 사용하여 아래 빈칸을 완성하시오.

(1)
Kevin: Where is the ABC bakery?
Jiho: Go straight one block and turn right. You'll find it on the left.

→ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________, he will find the ABC bakery on the left.

(2)
Mina: What is the blue button for?
Seho: Press it. The robot will start washing the dishes.

→ The robot _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________ Mina _____________ _____________ _____________ _____________.

(각 빈칸에 한 단어씩 쓸 것)
questions.explanation: (1) 명령문을 if 조건절로 변환하면, 주어 Kevin을 추가하고 현재시제로 표현. (2) 조동사 will이 있는 주절 앞에 if 조건절이 오며, 조건절의 동사는 현재시제 presses 사용.
